subject.title: Casa del Libro keeps active Mirakl offers for withdrawn stocks

question: Should the CDL fix first verify live Mirakl offer state before deleting local mk docs, seed orphan rows from snapshots, or do both in one operational reconciliation?
rationale: The code fix and the existing orphan cleanup affect external marketplace state and production data at batch scale, so maintainers need to choose the rollout and rate-limit posture before automation writes a patch.

options.title: Verify then reconcile
options.body: Keep withdrawn batch docs retryable until Mirakl confirms inactive state, and add a controlled reconciliation for already-orphaned live offers.

options.title: Rehydrate orphans first
options.body: Seed safe mk_casaDelLibro rows from fresh CDL snapshots so the existing withdraw cron can process them, leaving batch deletion hardening for a second change.

options.title: Manual cleanup only
options.body: Run an operational correction outside the code path and keep the code hardening as a separate marketplace task.

recommendation.title: Verify then reconcile
recommendation.body: Keep withdrawn batch docs retryable until Mirakl confirms inactive state, and add a controlled reconciliation for already-orphaned live offers.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier has the freshest Casa del Libro API touch plus the live operational context for this exact report.
